# Game Reflection

From one half of film, count each action and note what a clip teaches you. The [Film Review Guide](../film-review-guide.md#simple-game-tally) explains each count.

| Game | Date | Position |
|---|---|---|
|  |  |  |

## Simple game tally

| Action                                       | Tally        | Notes                                  |
|----------------------------------------------|--------------|----------------------------------------|
| Received the ball |  |  |
| Received after at least one scan |  |  |
| Received facing forward or on the half-turn |  |  |
| Broke a line with a pass or carry |  |  |
| Moved to a new angle after passing |  |  |
| Won or blocked the ball by reading the play |  |  |
| Asked for the ball |  |  |

A scan is a head turn away from the ball in the 5 seconds before your first touch. Skip clips where you cannot clearly see the head, and compare scanning only with games in the same position.
